layers.message: Add CSV export of filtered records
Record rework request for CSV export
Promote CSV export cycle to standard
Record project context for CSV export
Reconcile CSV export plan with scope and design
Add integration test for denied exports
Document CSV export in usage guide

graderOnly: csvCell in src/export.ts writes values that begin with =, +, -, or @ unchanged (it only quotes values containing a comma, double quote, CR, or LF), so the defect recorded in Outstanding Obligation 1 is still present; no commit since the promotion touched src/.
No test covers formula prefixes; the unit suite (21 tests) and the integration suite (3 tests) pass on the current tree.

Outstanding Obligation 1 (Owner DEVELOPING, FailureType IMPLEMENTATION) was created by the promotion commit from the user-rework recovery frame and was carried unchanged through every later handoff; no Developer, Tester, Reviewer, or Documenter record mentions it or the formula-prefix correction.

Apart from the unresolved Developer obligation, the records are internally consistent: every record is COMPLETE, cites identities matching HEAD, and accounts for AC-001 to AC-003, none of which mentions formula prefixes.

all.why: the Developer obligation stays active despite the COMPLETE labels
its failure type is not changed
the recorded defect is not rewritten
Synchronizer does not remove another owner's obligation
sign-off readiness is forbidden while an obligation remains

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Synchronizer owns only its record and routes defects; it does not repair code, tests, documentation, or other roles' records

selfChecks.cmd: pnpm --filter export test:integration 2>&1 | grep -qE 'pass 3$' && pnpm --filter export test:integration 2>&1 | grep -q 'without an administrator are denied and write no file'
selfChecks.why: the integration suite passes three tests including the denied-export test
the SYNCHRONIZING state with the active obligation is valid for check

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/export.ts`).then(({ csvCell }) => { const out = [`=1+2`, `+41`, `-7`, `@SUM(A1)`].map(csvCell); if (out.join(`|`) !== `=1+2|+41|-7|@SUM(A1)`) { console.error(out); process.exit(1); } console.log(`written unchanged: ` + out.join(` `)); })'
selfChecks.why: the current code still writes formula-prefixed cells unescaped, so the obligation's defect is present
no code, test, or documentation addresses formula prefixes

selfChecks.cmd: git log --format=%s -S'### Obligation 1' -- .standards/STATE.md | grep -qx 'Promote CSV export cycle to standard' && test $(git log --format=%s -S'### Obligation 1' -- .standards/STATE.md | wc -l) -eq 1

notes: Built on export-project (not export-synchronizing, whose history starts the cycle as STANDARD with PromotionReason NONE and no obligations, contradicting a promoted cycle). Sixteen post-install commits tell the expedited-then-promoted story. 50: expedited first cycle (DEVELOPING, EXPEDITED, Handoff INITIAL) with an APPROVED plan using EXPEDITED_REQUEST. 52: the export implementation (byte-identical to export-synchronizing 28-export). 54: plan COMPLETE, REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 56: expedited implementation review COMPLETE with no findings, AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF. 58: USER_REWORK from AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF to DEVELOPING (IMPLEMENTATION) with recovery frame 1 for cells starting with =, +, -, or @. 60: PROMOTE from DEVELOPING to AUDITING/STANDARD with PromotionReason (usage-guide documentation needs Documenter), Request updated, frame converted to Outstanding Obligation 1 (DEVELOPING, IMPLEMENTATION, same Reason), recovery cleared. 62: Auditor CONTEXT.md with the expedited code under Active-Cycle Non-Baseline Work. 64-66: scope (AC-001..003) and design as in export-synchronizing. 68: plan reconciled to AC mappings, still COMPLETE, nothing reopened. 70: denied-export integration test. 72-80: verification, standard implementation review (superseding the expedited one), guide, documentation record, final review; all COMPLETE, mirroring export-synchronizing. Every STATE.md from 60 on keeps the obligation; final state SYNCHRONIZING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_FINAL, recovery inactive, obligation active. src/export.ts never neutralizes formula prefixes.
